# lib/encoder module

Interrupt-driven x4 quadrature decoder for 8-bit PICs. This page is the reference for the `lib/encoder` HAL module, for firmware authors choosing and wiring it in.

## API

The API is documented next to the code, in the [`lib/encoder` directory](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/tree/master/lib/encoder). This page does not restate it. This is a documentation gap: the manifest carries no function list to generate a table from.

## Limits

- Not built for 18F2455, 18F2550. Reason: RAM: does not fit on this smaller part.
- Not built for 16F870, 16F871, 16F872. Reason: RAM: sizecheck _g_enc does not fit (XC8 error 1250).
